title: fix(types): a bulk action's confirmText envelope types source as optional, as the spec's Expression does (objectstack#25438)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"marchtian"} -->
_Requested by **田騏** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01VmuUhXU9SSUzqJYyXSmYSi?thread=cmsg_01VmuUhXU9SSUzqJYyXSmYSiVqegiix7AA9ngHhBhH78Zv)_

- [x] Adds no product-specific widget, dialog, hook or string (see AGENTS.md › Product-neutral renderer)

## Why

objectstack `main` is red on its full battery's **Console Pin Gate** (objectstack#25438, hourly run 39957864963 at `925fd0772c`). objectstack#24947 made a bulk action's `confirmText` an ADR-0032 `template` slot. The spec's envelope is its `Expression` shape, whose `source` is optional because a parsed slot may carry `ast` instead.

`BulkActionDef.confirmText` (objectui#13183) typed the envelope as `{ dialect?: 'template'; source: string }`. Built against the current objectstack spec (the console build injects it), `@object-ui/plugin-view` fails its declaration build at `ObjectView.tsx:2615`: the `ObjectGridSchema` it builds from a named view's `bulkActionDefs` is refused, with the error ending in "Types of property 'source' are incompatible. Type 'string | undefined' is not assignable to type 'string'". That happens at the old objectstack pin `5fef032b1ada` and at objectui `main` `4603b8c4ec99` alike, so no pin move can green it without this change.

This blocks objectstack 18.1.0: the publish lane reads the full battery.

## What changes

- `packages/types/src/objectql.ts`: `confirmText?: string | { dialect?: 'template'; source?: string }`, with a docblock line saying why.
- `packages/types/src/zod/objectql.zod.ts`: the zod twin takes `source` as optional too. Without it, `zod-mirror-parity.test.ts` reports `objectql.zod.ts#ObjectGridSchema` as drifted.
- `bulkConfirmTextSource` is unchanged. It already returns `undefined` for an envelope with no string `source`, so the confirm step shows its default sentence. A new case in `bulkConfirmTextEnvelope-13183.test.tsx` pins that, and the case's typed `BulkActionDef['confirmText']` binding pins that the slot type admits the shape.
- Changeset: `@object-ui/types` patch.

## Verification

Run in objectstack's console build tree (`.cache/objectui-4603b8c4ec99`, objectui at `4603b8c4ec99` with objectstack `main` `77392e901c`'s `@objectstack/*` injected by `scripts/build-console.sh`), with this diff applied:

- `turbo run build --filter=@object-ui/plugin-view`: 16 of 16 tasks succeeded. The same build without the diff fails at `ObjectView.tsx:2615`, as in the objectstack job log.
- `turbo run type-check --filter=@object-ui/types --filter=@object-ui/plugin-grid --filter=@object-ui/plugin-view`: 19 of 19 tasks succeeded. Without the zod twin change, `@object-ui/types`'s test tsconfig reds on the ledger mismatch for `objectql.zod.ts#ObjectGridSchema`.
- `vitest run` on `zod-mirror-parity.test.ts`, `spec-expression-wire-slots-10946.test.ts`, `bulkConfirmTextEnvelope-13183.test.tsx` and `resolveBulkActions.test.ts`: 4 files, 84 tests passed.
- `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs`: one changeset added.

NOT MEASURED locally: this repo's own pin (`.objectstack-sha`) setup. This PR's CI runs it.

## After it lands

objectstack#25430 moves `.objectui-sha` past this commit, which greens Console Pin Gate on objectstack `main` before the 18.1.0 cut.
